items.title: Comparing the two definitions of Tor independence over a flat algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two ways of expressing Tor independence for modules over a flat algebra, and its proof is a 51-line computation with a single external pointer. It writes both sides of the comparison as the homology of explicit complexes obtained by resolving the two modules, uses the flatness of the algebra to replace the derived tensor products by ordinary total complexes, and then identifies the two complexes by reordering the tensor factors. The identification is displayed in the source and each step is justified by either associativity of the tensor product or flatness.
